scope: Unauthenticated URLs, private participant links, expired-session recovery and book navigation against the running server; no ledger commands submitted
checks: A shared financing URL shows an entry screen and sends no unauthenticated requests
The entry screen has no ineffective reconnect or workspace evidence controls
A participant link for another server is rejected locally
The recorded handoff works without participant access
Pasting a real bank link enters the selected task and preserves appearance
Book to workspace navigation reuses the authenticated participant tab
An expired session stops after one rejection and explains how to recover
Session expiry preserves the unconfirmed request for reconciliation
The stale-session probe accounts for exactly one expected HTTP 401
A current buyer link recovers an expired session
A direct reviewer fragment enters without granting financing actions
No ledger commands were submitted by the entry checks
No unexpected browser or CSP errors
